story.title: Niet zomaar een
story.body1: Metro Momo begon met een simpel idee: de wereld heeft meer voedsel nodig dat mensen doet glimlachen. We namen de Himalayaanse momo — warm, troostend, gemaakt om te delen — en gaven het een frisse, moderne draai.
story.body2: Elke dumpling is met de hand geplooid, elke saus is huisgemaakt en elke locatie is ontworpen om aanvoelen als de coolste hangout van de buurt. We bouwen een merk dat zich net zo goed aanvoelt als het smaakt.

hero.subtitle: METRO MOMO was born from a simple belief: great dumplings deserve a great system.

story.title: Waarom we METRO MOMO startten
paragraphs: We groeiden op met MOMO die mensen bij elkaar bracht — rond straatkarren, familiekeukens en festivalkramen. Ze zijn niet zomaar een snack; ze zijn een reden om te pauzeren, te delen en te verbinden.

Toen we naar het foodlandschap keken, zagen we twee extremen: generieke fast-food ketens en mooie maar niet-schaalbare independents. METRO MOMO zit in het midden — een merk met echte culturele wortels en de operationele ruggengraat om over steden heen te groeien zonder zijn hart te verliezen.

Vandaag bouwen we een paraplu die onafhankelijke eigenaren samenbrengt onder één bewezen systeem. Elke partner behoudt zijn lokale identiteit en krijgt tegelijk het merk, de supply chain, de training en de technologie die normaal voor veel grotere ketens zijn weggelegd.

sidebar.title: Still have questions?
sidebar.text: Our partnership team is happy to talk through your specific situation.

items.question: Heb ik restaurant ervaring nodig?
items.answer: No. Our model is designed to be accessible for first-time operators as well as experienced business owners. We provide training, playbooks, and ongoing support so you can run the business confidently from day one.

items.question: Do I need a chef?
items.answer: No. METRO MOMO uses pre-portioned recipes and a simple preparation process that reduces kitchen complexity. Your team can be trained to produce consistent, high-quality MOMO without traditional chef experience.

items.question: What joint-venture formats are available?
items.answer: We offer three formats: Street Stall & Kiosk, Full Restaurant, and Virtual & Ghost Kitchens. Each has a different footprint and operational profile, with a €0 franchise fee and a revenue-sharing model. Visit our Models page to compare them.

items.question: What support will I receive?
items.answer: You receive onboarding, site selection guidance, training, supply chain access, marketing support, operational coaching, and launch assistance. Support continues after opening with reviews, menu updates, and community access.

items.question: How do I choose the right territory?
items.answer: Our team evaluates footfall, local competition, demographic fit, and your budget with you. We then protect your agreed territory so you can build your customer base without internal competition.

items.question: What is the application process?
items.answer: Submit your interest, attend a discovery meeting, complete an application and site review, sign the agreement and secure your territory, complete training, and launch. The full process is outlined on our How It Works page.

items.question: What technology is included?
items.answer: Every partner gets access to the Fewa restaurant operating system, including a central HQ dashboard, inventory and cost control, QR and online ordering, table booking, kitchen display, employee scheduling, and HACCP / hygiene checklists.

items.question: Can I use the Fewa operations app later?
items.answer: Yes. As the network grows, partners will be able to connect to the same operations platform that powers modern restaurant teams — covering ordering, kitchen, inventory, and back-office tools.

items.question: How long does it take to open?
items.answer: Timeline depends on the format. A street stall/kiosk or virtual/ghost kitchen can be ready in 6–10 weeks, while a full restaurant typically takes 3–6 months including site works, permits, and training.

hero.title: Built on a restaurant
hero.subtitle: Every METRO MOMO partner gets access to the same operations platform that runs modern restaurant teams — covering ordering, kitchen, inventory, and back-office in one place.

cta.title: Tech that scales with every format
cta.text: Whether you start with a street stall or a full restaurant, the platform grows with you. No separate software bills, no disconnected spreadsheets — one system from day one.
